metadata.title: Seventies Pop Portrait with Fog and Heavy Slab Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A full-body portrait of a male figure in 70s fashion emerging from a dense fog floor against a dark, moody background, topped with a heavy horizontal typographic bar.
excludeWhen: modern high-definition digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male subject in a white suit and dark open-collar shirt stands amidst thick, low-lying white fog. The background is a dark, desaturated blue-grey. A prominent horizontal band at the top contains ultra-bold, wide slab-serif lettering with a thin underline.
coreVisualRelationships: Fog obscuring the lower legs and feet
High contrast between white suit and dark background
Typography anchored to the top edge as a structural header
coreInvariants: Heavy horizontal rule under the header text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered, occupying the right two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white suit against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the heavy header text, moves down the vertical line of the subject, and settles into the fog at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space to the left of the subject and above the fog line.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the environment.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick horizontal and vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face paired with a thin horizontal rule.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule (underline) spanning the width of the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy square serifs and wide stance.
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight.
Captures the blocky, architectural feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 1970s white leisure suit and maroon shirt, standing in thick dry-ice fog against a dark blue-grey wall. Use a soft-focus film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, white, ultra-bold extended slab-serif text at the top, underlined by a thin maroon rule.

verificationChecks: Fog covers the feet and lower legs
Subject is wearing a white suit

postGenerationChecks: Is the text centered and heavy?
Does the fog look like dry ice vapor?
Is the color palette muted and retro?
Is the subject's pose characteristic of 70s pop photography?
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Fashion Style] + [Atmospheric Fog] + [Dark Background] + [Heavy Slab Serif Header]
